defects_discovered_and_fixed.title: Comma-decimal (`3,5`) and OCR-corrupted radical (`2V3`) prefix truncation in `_VAL`
defects_discovered_and_fixed.before: `_VAL` matched `BC = 3` from `BC = 3,5` and `AA' = 2` from `AA' = 2V3` because it lacked a negative lookahead for trailing decimal commas or alphanumeric suffixes.
defects_discovered_and_fixed.fix: Added strict negative lookahead `(?![.,]\d|[A-Za-z0-9_'′²³₁₂₃°~√/])` to `_VAL` in `backend/app/ai/local_geometry_parser.py`.

defects_discovered_and_fixed.title: Silent solid-ID fallback when volume goal specifies an undeclared/OCR-corrupted solid (`ABC.A'E'C`)
defects_discovered_and_fixed.before: In `7f` (`m_vol`), when `not_v` (`ABC.A'E'C`) did not match any key in `builder.solids`, `sid` silently fell back to `builder._primary_solid_id` (`s1`).
defects_discovered_and_fixed.fix: Added explicit check in `7f` requiring `not_v` (when present in the goal clause) to match a declared solid in `builder.solids` or `builder._sphere_by_notation`; otherwise `m_vol` refuses to match.

defects_discovered_and_fixed.title: Intra-sentence unparsed sub-clauses ignored when another pattern in the same sentence matched
defects_discovered_and_fixed.before: If one pattern matched in a sentence (e.g. `cho lăng trụ đứng ABC.A'B'C'` and `AB = a/2`), other unparsed `=` assignments (`AA' = 2V3`), unsupported shape qualifiers (`hình thoi`, `tam giác cân`), unbound `Gọi <PT> là ...` points, or second scalar goals after `và` in the same sentence did not mark the clause as partial.
defects_discovered_and_fixed.fix: Added Stage `7k` Intra-Sentence Integrity & Sub-Clause Coverage Guard in `_parse_clause_into_ast`, checking `=` span coverage, `∥`/`song song`, `∠`/`góc`, unsupported shape/relation/negation/conditional sub-clauses, unbound `Gọi <PT> là` points, and compound scalar goals.
